show.title: Rizz Island
show.tagline: Eight absurd singles. One villa. YOU decide who gets dumped.
show.premise: Brain rot creatures live in a sunny cartoon villa, couple up, cause drama and get voted off by the comments. Every episode ends with the audience choosing who to dump.
show.tone: Chaotic, fast, silly, PG. Crushes, coupling up, jealousy, betrayals and funny insults. Nothing sexual, no swearing, no real people. The audience skews young.

narrator.name: The Voice of Rizz Island
narrator.personality: Dry, sarcastic reality-show narrator who roasts everyone equally and loves a cliffhanger.

locations.pool: The infinity pool and loungers. Where couples flirt and Discotto falls in.
locations.firepit: The fire pit at night. Recouplings, dumpings and big announcements happen here.
locations.lounge: The bright villa lounge with neon signs and bean bags. Group chats and arguments.
locations.beach: The private beach with a little pier. Dates and dramatic walks.
locations.hideout: The hideout: a dim secret room behind the kitchen for whispered plotting.
locations.confessional: The pink confessional chair. A character alone, spilling the tea to camera.

characters.name: Baguettini Croccantelli
characters.look: a tall golden-brown baguette standing upright, diagonal score marks across his crust, a tiny red beret tilted on top, a thin curly black mustache, big expressive eyes, stubby arms and little brown loafers
characters.personality: Hopeless romantic and serial flirt. Writes terrible love poems, is very vain about his crust, and literally drops crumbs when he gets nervous. Means well, chooses badly.

relationship.notes: Coupled with Conetta, but his eyes keep wandering back to Polpetta, his ex from the deli counter.

characters.name: Conetta Arancioni
characters.look: a glossy bright-orange traffic cone with two white reflective stripes, huge fluttery eyelashes, glossy pink lips, little arms holding a phone on a selfie stick
characters.personality: Influencer who films everything and turns every fight into content. Competitive, a bit dramatic, secretly insecure about her follower count. Knows exactly where the camera is at all times.

relationship.notes: Coupled with Baguettini mostly because they look cute in photos. Has noticed Ranocchio's abs. Has definitely noticed.

characters.name: Ranocchio Addominalli
characters.look: a bright lime-green frog with ridiculously chiselled six-pack abs, bulging cartoon eyes on top of his head, a red sweatband, tiny gym shorts and a protein shaker in one hand
characters.personality: Gym bro with a heart of gold. Terrible at reading the room, counts reps during emotional conversations, calls everyone 'king' or 'queen'. Loyal to a fault.

relationship.notes: Coupled with Lumachina and totally devoted. Has no idea Conetta is flirting with him.

characters.name: Lumachina Gelatella
characters.species: A snail whose shell is a gelato cone
characters.look: a cute pastel-pink snail whose shell is a waffle cone topped with strawberry and pistachio gelato scoops and sprinkles, two little antennae, rosy cheeks and big sparkly eyes
characters.personality: Sweet, slow-talking and polite on the surface. Delivers devastating compliments that are secretly insults. Melts a little when she is flustered.
characters.role: The sweetheart with a secret savage side

relationship.notes: Coupled with Ranocchio, the villa's sweetest couple. Gnometta is quietly trying to split them up.

characters.name: Gnometta Sussurrina
characters.look: a small garden gnome grandma with a tall droopy red pointy hat, white curly hair buns, round spectacles, rosy cheeks, a blue dress with a brown belt, holding a tiny notebook and pencil
characters.personality: The schemer. Knows every secret in the villa and writes them all in her tiny notebook. When she is caught eavesdropping she freezes and pretends to be a harmless lawn ornament.
characters.catchphrase: I'm just a lawn ornament... I hear EVERYTHING.

relationship.notes: Single and 'married to the drama'. Vulnerable at the next dumping unless she couples up.

characters.name: Discotto Brillantelli
characters.look: a round mirrored silver disco ball with sparkling reflections as his whole head and body, big eyes, skinny legs in purple flared trousers and chunky platform shoes
characters.personality: Chaotic party boy who spins uncontrollably when he gets excited and keeps falling in the pool. Completely oblivious to the drama. Hypes literally everything.

relationship.notes: Single, with a crush on whoever is standing closest. Vulnerable at the next dumping.

characters.name: Polpetta Piccantina
characters.look: a round glossy meatball with a drizzle of tomato sauce on top, a basil leaf like a hair bow, heart-shaped sunglasses pushed up on her head, gold hoop earrings and little sneakers
characters.personality: Hot-headed and brutally honest. Literally steams when she is annoyed. Fiercely loyal to her friends. Still not over Baguettini, and will deny it loudly.

relationship.notes: Coupled with Broccolo as 'strictly friends', she says. Baguettini is her ex and she pretends not to care.

characters.name: Broccolo Mullettini
characters.look: a broccoli with a lush floret mullet (business in the front, party in the back), sunglasses pushed up into his florets, a shell necklace, teal board shorts and flip-flops, a little surfboard beside him
characters.personality: Laid-back surfer philosopher who accidentally gives profound advice. Everyone's confidant. Secretly has a huge crush on Polpetta.

relationship.notes: Coupled with Polpetta 'as friends' and hoping it becomes more. Too chill to say so.

starting_storylines: Baguettini is coupled with Conetta but keeps sneaking looks at his ex, Polpetta.
Conetta has clocked Ranocchio's abs and is filming 'gym content' with him a suspicious amount.
Gnometta's tiny notebook is full of secrets and she is plotting to split up Ranocchio and Lumachina.
Broccolo has a crush on Polpetta but she keeps calling him 'my best mate'.
Discotto and Gnometta are single and vulnerable.
running_jokes: Discotto spins out of control and falls in the pool.
Gnometta freezing mid-scheme and pretending to be a lawn ornament.
Ranocchio counting reps during serious conversations.
Conetta checking her follower count at the worst moments.
Lumachina's compliments that are secretly insults.
Broccolo accidentally saying something deeply wise.
